task: PR148 — Defensive realism, discipline and match cadence calibration

methodology.baseline: Pristine upstream PR147 4ae21ed13; copied observer-only calibration harness; same squads, seeds, roles and fixed 0.025-second engine.
methodology.football: Two 45-minute seeds per balanced/weak-vs-strong/aggressive fixture. Raw/per90 counts, player detail, ranges and hashes. Baseline aggressive failures are retained and excluded from completed-match distributions.
methodology.performance: Three serial normal 10-minute measurements per revision, same balanced:a seed/central midfielder, profiling disabled, 800-tick batches. No renderer, RAF or file-write cost included. Calibration timings under tests are descriptive only.
methodology.agency: Actual 90-minute meaningful opportunities with deterministic explicit DEV selection at exact tick boundaries; human thinking/browser time unmeasured. Optional balanced:a left-back and striker probes are exported separately in roleVariation90.
